sloka: ततस्तस्या नखैस्तीक्णैर्मर्माण्युत्कृत्य वानरः ।उत्पपाताथ वेगेन मनः संपातविक्रमः ॥५-१-१९४॥
transliteration: tatastasyā nakhaistīkṇairmarmāṇyutkṛtya vānaraḥ ।utpapātātha vegena manaḥ saṁpātavikramaḥ ॥5-1-194॥

translations.english: The vanara who had the speed of mind tore her vital parts with his sharp nails and rushed out quickly before she closed her mouth.
